$comment: NPC visitors. `visits`: when they come (skong-core `npc::VisitScheduler`). The countdown runs on presence time only (it stops while the user is away, idle `away_secs`, or a visitor is around): the first visit after `first` [min, max] s, then `gap` [min, max] s after each visit. A due visit waits while a fullscreen app / game is in front, the user types at least `busy_keys_per_sec`, or the knight is busy (asleep, held, fighting, a gauntlet, the troupe in town), re-checking every `retry` s, and comes as soon as the moment is good (also when no visitor or spot fit: it stays due); visits never stack up. Keep `first` and `gap` at most 1200 s: someone comes at least every 20 minutes of presence (a test holds this). The guarantee only picks among eligible visitors (`weight`, `after_fight`, not the same one twice in a row). Clips come from the exported vanilla libraries in data/hk/animations (NPC art is always vanilla: skins/Vanilla). `faces`: left|right (side-view art, mirrored to face the knight) or front (never mirrored; use talk/talk_right for direction). `arrive`: walk (in from the knight's monitor edge along the bottom), perch (sitting on a window edge), portal (steps out of a dream portal anywhere on the desktop), drop (falls out of a portal). `leave`: walk|fade|portal. `origin_above_feet` (game units) overrides the feet line measured from the idle frame (perched visitors: the seat line). `stand_off`: where the knight stands to talk (game units from the visitor). Lines are plain strings or {say, react}; `react` names knight acts from acts.json, `a|b` = first one that can start. Placeholders: {title} (a visible window title), {app} (a running app), {daypart}. `portal_style`: dust (small dust puffs + quick fade-in, default) or dream (dream-gate glow + ripple). `dream_thoughts`: what a visitor thinks when the knight dream-nails them after their talk (sometimes, never mid-conversation). `dream`: the knight's dream-nail thoughts per window (match = lowercase substrings of process name or title; an empty match is the generic pool). `clips.leave`: a clip played once before leaving (a bow). `handled`: the user can pick a visitor up and drop them elsewhere; `picked_up` lines are said as they're lifted, `set_down` lines when the scene they were in (a lesson, spar, calm scene, challenge) can't go on and they take their leave (a talk just pauses and goes on).`weight`: relative chance to be the next visitor (default 1). `after_fight` (s): only visits that soon after the knight fought (cursor battles, pestering, the Shade, spells; invitations by name ignore it). `demos`: named clip sequences the visitor can perform (a clip name, or {clip, secs} for looping clips). `lesson` (teachers, e.g. Sly): after the conversation a training session follows: `open_demo` once, then `count` drills from `drills` (the first always, the rest at random in listed order); each drill is announced (`say`, one picked), shown (`demo`), practised by the knight (`drill`: slash, up_slash, down_slash, dash, jump, or a knight act name such as great_slash), then answered from `praise` or `critique`; `closing` ends it, `abandon` is said when it is cut short; `stance` is the clip held while teaching, `practice_secs` how long the teacher waits for a drill. Feedback and closing lines may carry a `react` like conversation lines. `extra_libraries`: more clip libraries merged into the visitor's, clip names prefixed ({library, prefix}). `spar` (fighters, e.g. Zote): with probability `chance` the conversation ends in a challenge (one `challenge` line, `taunt` clip), then a short spar: on guard (`stance`, `pause` s), wind-up (`antic`), a charge along his ledge (`attack`, `charge_speed` units/s for `charge_secs`; catching the knight bumps him), `recover`; blows stagger him (`hit`); after `hits` blows he goes down (`fall`), gets up (`get_up`), says a `lose` line and leaves. `abandon` is said when it fizzles out (after `max_secs`, or the knight wandered off). `size`: his body [w, h] in game units. Spar lines are plain text (no placeholders). `company` (calm scenes): with probability `chance`, when the spot fits (`needs`: any; seat = a settled window edge the knight can sit on beside them; view = such a seat in the upper half of the monitor; deposit = a Geo deposit they arrived beside, which also places them there), the conversation ends in an invitation (one `invite` line), then they sit together: the visitor holds `clip` (default idle) and says one of `lines` every `every` s, the knight plays `knight` (acts from data/acts/company.json, `a|b` = first that can start) for `secs` (counted while he is beside them); a `parting` line, `clip_end` once, and they leave as usual. `abandon` is said when the knight is called away (the Shade, enemies, typing, a fullscreen app). Company lines are plain text. An `extra_libraries` entry may list `clips` (unprefixed) to merge only those (a boss library: only their sprites get rasterized). `challenge` (Hornet): with probability `chance` the conversation ends in a challenge, a race `race_share` of the time, else a duel. Race: she points out the finish (a `challenge` line), flings one of her spiked barbs (`throw_antic`/`throw`/`throw_recover`; the barb is a separate sprite: `barb` looped in flight at `barb_speed` and played now and then as it sits) onto a settled ledge the knight can reach `distance` units away, says a `go` line, and both race there; she runs (`run_speed`), ground-dashes, leaps (her clips), paced at `pace` x the knight's planned time; whoever gets within `reach` units of the barb first wins and it bursts (`burst`); she says a `win` or `lose` line and leaps away (`abandon` when called off; the barb bursts then too). The app draws a plain spiked ball if the barb art is missing. Duel: a `challenge` line, then quick guards (`pause`), lunges (`lunge_speed` for `lunge_secs`), needle throws (`throw_reach`, `throw_secs`), silk spheres (`sphere_radius`, `sphere_secs`) and step-backs; she can be struck only on guard or recovering and never goes down; after `wins_after` touches on the knight (or `max_secs`) she ends it with her `win` pose and a `win` line (`respect` after `respect_after` of his blows). Challenge lines are plain text. All lines are original writing.

npcs.name: cornifer

picked_up: Up, up? I'd rather chart the ground, thank you!
set_down: Well! I've quite lost my place. I'll wander on and find it again.

idle_lines: Now, where does this ledge go...
Hmmm-hm. A little more ink here...
dream_thoughts: ...wonder if the little one will keep the map. They never keep the map.
Hmm hm hmm... one more ledge and I am finished. One more...
Did I leave the quill by the {app} window? Oh dear.

invite: Out with your map, then! Let's see whose is the less wrong.
Sit with me a moment? Two maps are better than one smudge.
Ah, you carry a map too! Come, come, let's compare.
lines: Hm-hm-hmm... this window wasn't here this morning.
Hmm hm hmmm... your ledge goes much further than mine.
La-la, hm-hm... a bench, you've drawn? Clever, clever.
Hmmm... no, no, your north is right. Mine wandered off.
Hm-hm, hmmm... a little more ink, just about there...
parting: There! Both maps a little truer. Off you go, explorer.
Well! I think we each learnt something. Mostly about smudges.
Hm-hm... I'll be off. Keep that map dry, little one.
abandon: Oh! Off already? Keep the map, keep the map!
Called away, are we? Another time, then. Hm-hm.

conversations.say: Oh! A fellow explorer, all the way up here!

conversations: I've been charting this {app} country all {daypart}. The walls keep moving!

conversations.say: Here, take a copy. It's a bit smudged, but it's honest work.
Ah, hello there! Mind the papers, mind the papers!

conversations: I've mapped '{title}' twice now. It looked different both times.

conversations.say: One for you, little traveller. Hm-hm-hmmm...

conversations: Hm? Oh, it's you! Lost again, are we?
These glowing plains are much bigger than they look from below.

conversations.say: Take this map. I'll draw myself another.

npcs.name: quirrel

picked_up: Ha! A new vantage, unasked for.
set_down: I think I'll take that as my cue to move on. Be well.

dream_thoughts: ...so much I still want to see. So little I remember.
That little one is braver than they look.
Just a moment longer, then I move on.

invite: Sit a while, if you like. A view is better shared.
There's room up here for two. Take a moment.
Stay, just for a little. See how far it all goes from here.
lines: All those little lights, every one of them busy.
Listen. Even the windows have a quiet hum to them.
I could sit here until I forget why I came. That happens to me.
Strange. I feel I've sat like this before, somewhere far below.
parting: Thank you for the company. I think I'll walk on now.
That was nice. Let's both remember it, if we can.
Time I was moving. Take care up here, little one.
abandon: Ah, you're needed. Go on, I'll keep the view for you.
Off you go, then. The view will wait.

conversations: Ah, we meet again, little wanderer.

conversations.say: I sat down for a moment and ended up watching your {app} for an age.

conversations: Strange, how a place can feel so familiar. Safe travels.
Good {daypart}! Quite the view from up here, isn't it?

conversations.say: All these windows... each one a little kingdom with its own light.

conversations: I think I'll stay a while longer. Go on, don't let me keep you.
You again! You certainly get around.

conversations.say: Have you ever wondered who arranges all these windows?

conversations: Hmm. Perhaps some things are best left a mystery.

npcs.name: myla

set_down: Dizzy, dizzy... I'll go dig somewhere still. Bye-bye!

idle_lines: Tap, tap, the stone says hello... la-la-la...
Dig a little, sing a little, dig a little more~
Down where the lamps all glow, la-di-da...
dream_thoughts: ...one more swing, and one more song, and one more...
The little one listened! Hardly anybody listens.
Is the stone humming back? I think it's humming back.
conversations: Oh! Hello! Did you hear me singing? I'm not very good.
There's Geo in this {app} rock, I can tell. It sparkles at me.
You can dig some too. There's plenty, if you knock nicely.
Hi hi! Mind your head, the pick swings wide.
I followed the shine all the way up here. Isn't it pretty?

conversations.say: Want to hear my digging song? It's short. Mostly.

conversations: Hello, little friend! Come to dig too?
I don't know whose window this is, but the stone in it is lovely.
Every rock has a little song inside. You just have to knock.

invite: Stay and listen? I sing better with someone near.
Sit, sit! I'll dig and sing, and you can count the swings.
Here goes my mining song. Don't laugh. Well, a little.
lines: Tap the stone and the stone taps back~
Deep and dark, but my lamp is bright~
Swing, and chip, and the Geo shines~
Ooh, the rock is cold but the song is warm~
parting: That's the whole song! There's more, but I forget it.
Thank you for listening! The rock's all yours now.
All sung out. Go on, the shiny bits are yours.
abandon: Oh, you're off? I'll finish it for the rock, then.
Bye bye! I'll keep singing anyway.

npcs.name: zote

picked_up: Unhand me! A knight stands on his own legs!
set_down: Hmph. I was leaving anyway. Of my own will, mind you.

dream_thoughts: ...did they see me trip? They saw me trip.
Must practise the landing. Again. Tomorrow.
Nobody will ever know about the fall. Nobody.

challenge: Enough talk! Raise that little nail and face me. I shall go easy on you. Probably.
A duel! Right here, on this very window. Try to keep up, small one!
Have at you! Zote never refuses a sparring partner. Even a tiny one.
lose: I slipped. Clearly I slipped. That ledge is far too smooth.
A draw! A glorious draw, in which I happened to be lying down.
I let you win. A good teacher does that. You may thank me later.
My cloak was caught on the window frame. Otherwise... well. You saw nothing.
abandon: Hmph. You flee from greatness. I understand.
Enough. You have learned all you can from me today.

conversations: Halt! You stand before Zote the Mighty, conqueror of this {app} realm!

conversations.say: You may admire my landing. It was entirely on purpose.
Rule Fifty-Three: never trust a window that opens by itself. Remember it well!

conversations: You! Small one! Did you witness my glorious descent?

conversations.say: Do not be ashamed. Few could survive such a fall. I barely noticed it.

conversations: Now begone. I have an important {daypart} nap to... guard.
Ah. The little knight. Still trailing after me, I see.

conversations.say: I shall allow it. Observe greatness from a respectful distance.

conversations: Rule Twelve: always land on your feet. Or your head. Both are fine.

npcs.name: elderbug

set_down: That's enough excitement for these old legs. I'll be going.

dream_thoughts: ...such a kind little one. I do hope they come back.
Everyone leaves in the end. But they always visit first.
Perhaps I should get out more. Perhaps.
conversations: Oh my, a visitor! Hardly anyone stops by to chat anymore.

conversations.say: Isn't it a lovely {daypart}? The screen is so bright and warm.

conversations: Go on then, young adventurer. Do come back and say hello.
Hello, hello! You're looking well, little one.

conversations.say: I was just admiring '{title}'. Such a curious name for a place.

conversations: Take care up on those high windows. They close without warning, you know.
Ah, it's you! I was hoping you'd pass by.
Everyone hurries so these days. Clicking here, typing there...

conversations.say: But you always find a moment for an old bug. Thank you.

npcs.name: hornet

set_down: Enough games. We'll settle it another day.

dream_thoughts: ...they have grown. Good. They will need it.
Do not get attached, Hornet. Do not.
Hmph. Still, it was good to see them.
conversations: Little ghost. So you've found yourself a strange new kingdom.

conversations.say: These windows open and close without warning. Stay sharp.

conversations: I'll be watching. Don't disappoint me.
Hmph. Still here, I see.

conversations.say: Your {app} hums like a nest full of weavers.

conversations: Our paths will cross again. Try to keep up.

conversations.say: You've grown quicker. Good.

conversations: Not every glowing thing up here is friendly. Remember that.
Farewell, little ghost.
There you are. Idle, as usual.

conversations.say: All this glass and light, and you just stand on it.
Keep moving, little ghost. Stillness makes you prey.

challenge: See where my barb lands? Reach it before I do.
A race, little ghost. To my barb. Try to keep up.
Legs this time, not nails. First to the spikes wins.
win: Too slow. The barb was mine before you left the ground.
Again, when you've grown some speed.
lose: ...You were faster. Don't let it go to your head.

challenge: Show me how you've grown. Ready your nail.
Spar with me. I won't hold back much.
Your guard is lazy. Let me fix that.
win: That's enough. You drop your guard after every swing.
Done. Watch my feet next time, not my needle.
Too slow to recover. Fix that.
Hm. You chase. A fighter should make the other one chase.
respect: You found a few openings. I noticed. Don't make a habit of it.
Those blows were real. The duel is still mine.
Better. Much better. Not enough, but better.

npcs.name: sly

picked_up: Tch. Has no one any manners?
set_down: The lesson is over. Practise on your own.

idle_lines: Hm. Where has my student got to?
dream_thoughts: ...not bad, for one so small. Not bad at all.
Did I ever stand that stiffly? Surely not.
Hm. I may have been too strict. No. Just strict enough.
conversations: So. The little one who picks fights with cursors.

conversations.say: I watched you. Brave, yes. Tidy, no.
Come. Let us see what your nail remembers.

conversations: There you are. I felt the air stir three windows away.

conversations.say: Spirit you have plenty of. Form is another matter.
A short lesson, then. Pay attention.

conversations: Good {daypart}, young one. Your stance gave you away before you did.

conversations.say: Even out here among the {app} windows, an idle nail grows dull.
Draw it. We practise.

say: Three cuts at the empty air. Clean, not fast.
Strike the air before you. Three times. Mind your feet.
Now upward. Cut what hangs above you.
Up. As if a lantern-fly dared to hover there.
Leap, and strike downward on the way back to earth.
Jump. Cut beneath you before you land.
Jump. Then again from the air, if your wings allow.
Show me your leaps. High, and land softly.
Dash out and back. Short, sharp, no stumbling.
Cover the ground. Out, then back to me.
Gather your strength, then spend it in one great cut.
The great slash. Hold... and release.
Spin, and let the nail carry you round.
The cyclone. Do not let it make you dizzy.
Charge, lunge, cut. All one motion.
The dash slash. Close the distance before they blink.

praise.say: Good. Your nail remembers more than you do.

critique.say: Too eager. The nail leads, not your feet.
Sloppy. A mosscreep would laugh at that.
You flinched. Again, and do not flinch.
Hm. We will call that a beginning.

closing.say: Enough for today. Practise while the screen sleeps.
That will do. A nail is sharpened by use, not by talk.
Go on, then. And keep your eyes open when you fight cursors.

abandon: Ah. You are needed elsewhere. Another time.
Hm. The screen calls. We stop here.

thoughts: warning: 1 bug detected on title bar.
it's not a bug. it's a feature. it has a nail.
bug report: it is looking at me.
debugging... the bug refuses to leave.
status: WON'T FIX. bug is cute.
